content:
Anya: Heads-up 3 webinar format locked: 40min content + 15min live Q&A. We're doing micro-demos (90s live run + 30s takeaway) to keep energy high. Need assets from speakers by EOD Friday.
Marcus: got it. what exactly do you want for each demo?
Anya: checklist below. keep it minimal so we can iterate quickly.
Dee: can we automate the rehearsal booking? timezone juggling is rough.
OpsBot: I can schedule once you post preferred slots here. I will create Zoom links + calendar invites tagged #webinar-rehearsal and post a short checklist in the event description.
Anya: perfect. REQUIRED per speaker (single zip or shared drive link):
1) 2-slide storyboard PDF (slide1 = 90s live demo steps, slide2 = 30s takeaway + CTA)
2) prompts.txt (3 prompts: happy_path, edge_case, fallback)
3) expected_outputs.md (one example output per prompt; keep to ~50-120 chars)
4) latency_notes.txt (any dev infra latency observed, p50/p95 in ms)
5) short bio + headshot (square 400px)
Marcus: for prompts.txt format, prefer examples?
Anya: plain text lines like:
```
happy_path: "Summarize this API changelog in 3 bullets for a PM."
edge_case: "Very long changelog (>3k chars) - extract top-3 impact items."
fallback: "If latency > 600ms, switch to compact-v2 and run same prompt."
success: "3 accurate bullets, no new features hallucinated."
```
Priya: how strict are we on the fallback model? will marketing ops coordinate with infra?
Anya: Ben in infra will own model fallback policies. if dev p95 > 500ms tag @Ben and use compact-v2. We'll capture which fallback was used in the post-webinar eval.
Dee: rehearsal cadence suggestion: Week before: two dry runs (speaker-only 30m each). Week of: full run-thru with panel + tech check.
Marcus: propose dry runs Tue 14:00-16:00, Wed 09:00-12:00 slots open for speaker-only. Full dress Fri 10:00.
OpsBot: Marcus's slots noted. Speakers, post preferred 2-hour windows and I'll create events.
Anya: Q&A flow: first 5 mins audience icebreaker (poll), next 10 mins targeted product questions, final 15 mins deep technical prompts (we'll route to infra/product SMEs). Moderator = Marcus, Q&A lead = Priya.
Priya: I'll set up the poll (3 quick choices) and capture top question themes.
Marcus: also want a tiny runbook for fail behavior: if demo model stalls > 10s per token, switch to recorded demo snippet and continue.
Anya: add to checklist: recorded 90s demo mp4 (in case live demo fails).
Dee: any measurement for success other than registrants?
Anya: yes 3 primary metrics: registrant->attendee % (target 50%), live demo success rate (target 95% without fallback), post-webinar MQLs from engaged attendees (target 40). We'll pull token/latency logs for every demo prompt and attach to the webinar postmortem.
Marcus: I'll create a short tracker sheet for each speaker: slot, assets received, demo latency, fallback used, recorded fallback used, notes.
OpsBot: creating #webinar-rehearsal Zooms once slots are confirmed. I will also post the calendar ICS in this thread.
Anya: final: speakers, drop your zip or shared link here by EOD Friday. Tag @OpsBot with your preferred rehearsal windows. We'll confirm times by Monday. :rocket:
